note: Re-judged 2026-11-10 (independent closure auditor, spec-ipsec-esp-offer-requires-esn) after affa3d8684 and da3ff616f6. Section 3.3.6: "if the responder receives a transform that it does not understand, or one that contains a Transform Attribute it does not understand, it MUST consider this transform unacceptable; other transforms with the same Transform Type are processed as usual." TestRFC7296UnacceptableTransformLeavesSiblingsOnOffer changed only by adding the ESN 0 transform to each of the six ESP offers (judge-approved in affa3d8684, RFC 7296 Section 3.3.3 makes ESN mandatory for ESP). ESN is understood and carries no attribute, so a match can still only come from the understood ENCR or INTEG sibling, in both orders; an implementation that refused the type or the proposal for one unacceptable transform still turns it red. The negative TestRFC7296UnacceptableTransformAloneRefusesTheProposal already carried ESN in its ESP control and cases, so the mask leaves its isolation unchanged. Records: the negative revert on espProposalMatches is re-recorded; the positive revert record on initiator.go::appendIKECombinations reads unit-changed in ./le rfc check and is owed a re-record. Retain enforced. Prior judgement: Judged 2026-09-30 at the producers after the D-8 fix: wire Transform.AttrsUnderstood (attrFormats, Key Length only); appendIKECombinations and espProposalMatches drop a transform carrying an unknown attribute and keep its siblings, and refuse the proposal only when an offered type loses every transform (IKEProposal.UnacceptableTransformType -> ErrTransformUnacceptable in ikeProposalComplete; ESP offered!=usable). This matches Section 3.3.6: the transform is unacceptable, other transforms of the same type are processed as usual, and a type with nothing acceptable leaves no complete set to select. Negative TestRFC7296UnacceptableTransformAloneRefusesTheProposal: unknown ENCR id alone, and each IKE type (ENCR/PRF/INTEG/D-H) and ESP type (ENCR/INTEG/ESN) carrying attribute 99 alone is refused, with a per-type control without the attribute accepted, so the attribute is the only difference (isolated); this failed before the fix. Positive TestRFC7296UnacceptableTransformLeavesSiblingsOnOffer: the unknown-id and unknown-attribute transform beside an understood sibling, both orders, IKE accepted with the sibling's ENCR and ESP matched (catches an over-reaction that refuses the type or proposal). ESP response is built from config, so no unacceptable attribute is echoed. HEAD crypto/engine tags remain supplementary. Records: appendIKECombinations +, espProposalMatches -, observed red.
